title: S5a — Validate protocol on a remote gateway
description: SPEC.md sections 5.1, 14, and 41 require usable remote service routing. S5 established local HTTP/WebSocket/reset/step/state; no remote gateway is configured. Obtain an authorized remote OpenShell 0.1.2 gateway/workspace and a pullable immutable EchoEnv image compatible with its compute driver. Extend the opt-in probe beyond local image IDs, preserve TLS verification, test service authentication with an unmodified OpenEnv client, repeat reset/step/state and ping/pong, and verify cleanup. Record remote evidence in docs/protocol-spike.md; do not infer remote compatibility from the local VM run.
notes: Blocked: only the local openshell gateway at https://localhost:17670 is registered (openshell gateway list --output json). Need authorized remote gateway/workspace access and a pullable immutable image; checked-in sha256 ID exists only in the local Docker store.

title: M3 — Milestone acceptance gate / v0.1 release
description:
Migrated milestone gate from TODO.md. Verify against SPEC.md; close only with test/documentation evidence.

Every acceptance criterion in §39 of `SPEC.md` is checked,
CI and E2E are green, the quickstart is reproducible, and no sandbox leaks in
success or failure tests.

Release checklist (all items remain unverified):

Use this compact checklist at the M3 gate; evidence should point to tests or
documentation rather than merely changing the box.

- ⬜ Existing OpenEnv clients need no source changes.
- ⬜ The environment runs inside OpenShell and is reachable only through its
  managed service route.
- ⬜ `/health`, `/ws`, `reset`, `step`, and `state` all work.
- ⬜ Normal close and every tested startup failure delete owned sandboxes.
- ⬜ `stop_container()` is idempotent and `keep_sandbox` is explicit.
- ⬜ Explicit policies are supported and never silently broadened.
- ⬜ Network and filesystem denials are demonstrated.
- ⬜ Unit tests require no OpenShell installation; real E2E tests are separate.
- ⬜ The README quickstart and canonical demo work from a clean environment.
- ⬜ Package, compatibility, typing, lint, test, and coverage checks pass.
acceptance_criteria:
Every acceptance criterion in §39 of `SPEC.md` is checked,
CI and E2E are green, the quickstart is reproducible, and no sandbox leaks in
success or failure tests.
